caption:
Sell a rental and delay the tax bill. It's called a 1031 exchange.

Normally, when you sell a rental for a profit, you owe tax on the gain.

With a 1031 exchange, the sale money goes to a qualified intermediary (a middleman), not you, and buys your next investment property.

The clock: 45 days to identify the new property, 180 days to close.

The tax isn't erased, it's deferred, so more of your money keeps working.

The rules are strict. This is education, not tax advice: work with a tax professional.
